name: MetaWin staking USD reward settled at FCN/USDT pair balance spot price
summary: The staking contract 0x431abb27dab05f4e7cdeaa18390fe39364197500 accrues each staker a reward denominated in USD and settles it in FCN at a price it derives, inside the paying transaction, from two raw balanceOf reads on the PancakeSwap V2 FCN/BSC-USD pair 0xacb496dd4a8b6b9d1b99d422b8700f6ef932bc10. In the anchor transaction the claim entry point, selector 0xd9574d4c, reads the caller's stored 10e18 USD entitlement from slot 0x9c6375cda627d083cbb712ee89f8748935cee8e2ed0be5ca571a2fdf7ae3eba3, reads BSC-USD.balanceOf(pair) = 0.02 and FCN.balanceOf(pair) = 0.501971077397338362, and pays out 10 / (0.02 / 0.501971077397338362) = 250.985538698669186971 FCN. Those pair balances are what the caller had just set: the same transaction is a PancakeSwap flash swap that removed 512963.341056079475662703 BSC-USD from that exact pair before calling the claim. The invariant violated is that a fixed USD liability may not be settled at an instantaneous, caller-controllable AMM quote; there is no TWAP, no minimum-reserve or deviation guard, no getReserves-versus-balance check and no re-entrancy or flash-loan protection on the read. No parameter value repairs it: the reward rate, the priced pair and the fee split are configuration, and at any non-zero entitlement a claimer who can move the pair's balances within the transaction converts that entitlement into an arbitrary quantity of FCN.
notes: Created by a top-level creation from the EOA 0x1abeab1ab075a7188d23dded842b2c7f41cf3e11, which also deployed the FCN token and is not an attacker address. The 7,131-byte runtime hashes to 0x792ee11bff922205f25d997d5ca9e1e947faa1c6fad59f93eabf832b17243102 at the creation block, at the block before the exploit and at block 33990000, and the address is empty at block 33936241; the EIP-1967 implementation slot reads zero at the pre-exploit block and the exploit trace contains no DELEGATECALL out of the contract, so the runtime is direct and immutable and deployment is the only executable-code change.

Exact depletion of the PancakeSwap V2 FCN/BSC-USD pair 0xacb496dd4a8b6b9d1b99d422b8700f6ef932bc10 in the anchor transaction: its BSC-USD balance fell from 512963.361056079475662703 to 10000.020000000000000000. The flash swap took 512963.341056079475662703 BSC-USD and was repaid with 10000 BSC-USD and 85 FCN, and the attacker's contract forwarded 503468.345335579475662703 BSC-USD to its EOA in the same transaction, so the realised proceeds and the pool depletion agree to the ~505 BSC-USD the contract already held. BSC-USD is taken at par. The staking contract's whole FCN reward pool was also taken - its balance fell from 252.989548188125072069 to 2.004009489455885098 FCN, 225.886984828802268274 FCN to the attacker and 25.098553869866918697 FCN to the protocol fee address 0x19c4a6b4abfe88161f07c4fa2229a4120acfd7d5 - but that FCN is not valued separately: its only realisable value was the BSC-USD the attacker took out of the same pair, so counting both would double count, and FCN could never have been marked at the pair's pre-attack implied price of about 1,021,900 USD per token against a 0.501971077397338362 FCN reserve. The attacker sold part of the residual FCN back into the same pair over the following two days; that tail is mixed with third-party trading in the pool balance and is not attributed here, so this figure is a lower bound on the campaign total.

The staking contract 0x431abb27dab05f4e7cdeaa18390fe39364197500 is unverified on BscScan, so the root cause is established from the call trace, the exact call arguments and return values of its two balanceOf reads, the prestateTracer read of its 10e18 entitlement slot and the arithmetic identity 10 / (0.02 / 0.501971077397338362) = 250.985538698669186971 rather than from source. Function names are therefore given as selectors.
